body.x: S-Energy(www.s-energy.com) will be introducing its operation & maintenance(O&M) service and fuel cell at Korea Energy Show 2016, which will run Nov. 8-11 at KINTEX.

It is a company that manufactures and sells modules, and also participates in running projects, solar power house/power plant renting, power plant management and operation, fuel cells for buildings, ESS, tracker & crane system, and floating solar power system.

S-Energy was selected as the world's top three global top tier company according to the report "Global Photovoltaic Market Outlook of First Quarter of 2015" compiled by Bloomberg New Energy Finance. It has a group of specialists in engineering, finance, and law for fast response and optimum performance in projects. In the show, it will display its solar power houses, power plant rental business, and its fuel cell "Ecogener" series.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by Korea Energy Agency, Korea Energy Show 2016 is a comprehensive trade show covering new energy business, new and renewable energy, high-efficiency energy, energy environment, and energy policy technology. It was prepared to provide marketing support to the energy companies to contribute to the development and stimulation of the energy industry of Korea.
